surface: Boomi Integration Build canvas, platform.boomi.com, Chrome extension

method.why_dom_not_screenshot: The canvas renders at a devicePixelRatio of 2.5, so screenshot pixel coordinates are not CSS coordinates and the third shape sat outside the captured viewport. Shape and edge positions are therefore read from the live DOM via getBoundingClientRect, and each reading is attributed to the component whose name is visible in the editor header at the moment of measurement.
method.shape_selector: .shapeLabel (visible only; the inactive component panel's nodes have zero-area boxes)
method.edge_selector: .gwt-connectors-path-connected (a drawn, attached connector; the palette's shape icons live under .shape_palette_widget and are excluded)
method.trap_recorded: A first pass matched three elements labelled Start / Process Call / Stop via alt-text and looked like a surviving orphan. All three resolved to shape_palette_widget entries at 0x0 — the left-hand shape palette, not the canvas. A second pass, taken immediately after a URL-hash navigation, reported the previous component's canvas because the Boomi SPA keeps open component tabs mounted and does not re-render on a hash change alone; it was corrected by a hard reload plus a visible-header attribution check.

probe_6_1_answer.question: Strip vs store: does Boomi strip the dragpoint of an empty-returnpaths Process Call on save?
probe_6_1_answer.evidence: The pre-fix control was read back through the Component API after save: the shape2 -> shape3 dragpoint is still present in the stored component, while the canvas draws no such edge. The platform therefore STORES the contradiction rather than stripping it, so the P0 escalation condition in the bug report's severity line does NOT trigger; the defect is a canvas/graph-validity defect at P1, as filed.
probe_6_1_answer.comparison_level: GRAPH, not bytes. Submitted bytes are never compared against a readback in this repo: a readback carries server-assigned attributes and would differ on every healthy apply (models/authoring_workflow.py, submitted_xml_digest). What was checked is that the dragpoint, the stop shape and the returnpaths element survive the round trip as authored.
